Package qupath.ext.omero.core.pixelapis.web

Class WebApi

java.lang.Object
qupath.ext.omero.core.pixelapis.web.WebApi
All Implemented Interfaces:
AutoCloseable, PixelApi
public class WebApi extends Object implements PixelApi
This API uses the OMERO JSON API to access pixel values of an image. It doesn't have dependencies but can only work with 8-bit RGB images, and the images are JPEG-compressed.

    • createReader

      public PixelApiReader createReader(long imageId, qupath.lib.images.servers.ImageServerMetadata metadata, List<String> args)
      Creates a WebReader that will be used to read pixel values of an image.

      Note that you should close the returned reader when it's no longer used. As a precaution, this pixel API will (if needed) close them when it itself is closed, but it's better if they are closed as soon as possible.

      Note that if this API is not available (see isAvailable()), calling this function will result in undefined behavior.

      Specified by:
      createReader in interface PixelApi
      Parameters:
      imageId - the ID of the image to open
      metadata - the metadata of the image to open
      args - additional arguments to change the reader creation: JPEG_QUALITY_PARAMETER to a float between 0 and 1 to change the JPEG quality of the returned images
      Returns:
      a new web reader corresponding to this API
      Throws:
      IllegalArgumentException - when the provided image cannot be read by this API (see PixelApi.canReadImage(PixelType, int))
